name: coreSocial: Social Networks Sharing
author: Milan Petrovic

sections.description:
coreSocial plugin implements two major features in one plugin: sharing posts or pages on social networks, and linking social networks and website profiles. coreSocial includes blocks for use in the Block Editor for adding share posts and list of profiles with wide range of options for styling.

Social Networks Sharing

Plugin can add a group of buttons for sharing posts, pages, or any URL on the website via social networks of your choice. Plugin tracks in the database each time any button is clicked, so it can display these counts inside the buttons. These counts don’t guarantee that someone actually shared anything, only that the button is clicked, and sharing was initialized. For some networks, plugin can get real counts from the networks, but that is not widely supported by every social network.

Supported networks:
* Bluesky (with option to add account to link and hashtags)
* Twitter / X (with option to add account to link and hashtags)
* Facebook (with support for getting actual share counts via Facebook API)
* Tumblr (with support for getting actual share counts)
* Pinterest (with support for getting actual share counts)
* Reddit
* LinkedIn
* Flipboard
* Threads
* Hacker News

Additional share buttons:
* Gmail (open a new email with the page title and URL)
* MailTo (link with the open mail to format)
* Print (link to open the native print dialog)

Threads, Hacker News, and Gmail are disabled by default. Enable the networks and select them in the share methods where they should appear.

Adding Share Buttons

Plugin can add share buttons automatically via plugin settings for selected post-types. But if you want, you can use Block to add share buttons anywhere, supporting the Full Site Editing templates too. With the use of block, share buttons can be added anywhere on the website where the block editor is used.

Profiles Linking

If you want to add links to your social network profiles or website, with the colorful buttons, with icons; followers counts (added manually), different layouts, coreSocial supports close to 40 different networks and other relevant methods and websites.

Blocks

Plugin adds two blocks for both features, and these have a huge number of settings and customizations to make the buttons look the way you want them.

Elementor Widgets

With Elementor 4 and Atomic widgets enabled, you can add share buttons and social profiles using dedicated coreSocial widgets. The Pro edition also includes an Explore widget for AI assistants.

Plugin Home Page

  • Learn more about the plugin: coreSocial Home Page
  • Plugin knowledge base: coreSocial on Dev4Press
  • Support for the Lite version: Support Forum on Dev4Press

coreSocial Pro

coreSocial Lite, available on WordPress.org, is a fully functional plugin. coreSocial Pro adds AI exploration, more sharing options, and additional integrations:

  • Like Button: add a Like button to the share block.
  • QR Code Button: display a QR code for the current post or page from the share block.
  • Floating Bar: keep share buttons visible on the left or right side of the screen.
  • bbPress Integration: add sharing directly to topics and replies.
  • Button Display: order buttons by count and limit the number of visible buttons, with an option to expand the rest.
  • Messaging Apps: share via Telegram, WhatsApp, Viber, and Messenger.

Telegram, WhatsApp, Viber, and Messenger are disabled by default. Enable them and select them in the share methods where they should appear. Messenger also requires an App ID and redirect URL in its network settings.

Viber sharing requires the mobile app. Viber may trim messages longer than 200 characters, including long URLs.

Explore with AI (Pro)

Let visitors explore the current page with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, or Grok. Explore opens the selected AI assistant with a prompt containing the page title and URL.

  • Add Explore using a block, an Elementor 4 Atomic widget, the [coresocial-explore] shortcode, or a template function.
  • Choose and customize providers, button labels, and colors in the AI Networks settings panel.
  • Set the default prompt, layout, styling, and click-count display in the Explore with AI settings panel.
  • Customize the prompt for individual blocks, widgets, or shortcodes using {title} and {url} placeholders.
  • Order buttons by click count and limit the visible buttons, with an option to expand the rest.
  • Track Explore button clicks separately from social shares.

Gemini uses a copy-and-open dialog: copy the prompt, open Gemini, and paste it into a new chat. Provider sign-in and access to the page depend on the AI website. Explore counts track button clicks, not completed conversations.

More exclusive Pro features will be coming with future updates. Upgrade to coreSocial Pro.
sections.installation:
General Requirements

  • PHP: 8.1 or newer

PHP Notice

  • Plugin doesn’t work with PHP 8.0 or older versions.

WordPress Requirements

  • WordPress: 6.7 or newer

WordPress Notice

  • Plugin doesn’t work with WordPress 6.6 or older versions.

Basic Installation

  • Plugin folder in the WordPress plugins should be coresocial.
  • Upload coresocial folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  • Plugin adds new top level menu called ‘coreSocial’.
  • Check all the plugin settings before using the plugin.
  • In the Block Editor, you can add blocks listed under coreSocial category.
sections.faq:
Where can I configure the plugin?

The plugin adds top level ‘coreSocial’ panel in WordPress Admin menu.
